# visualization.fit_plots.plot_fit { #fmrimod.visualization.fit_plots.plot_fit }

```python
plot_fit(
    fit,
    kind='betas',
    voxel=None,
    level=0.95,
    sample_at=None,
    direct_labels=True,
    title=None,
    subtitle=None,
    caption=None,
    figsize=None,
    ax=None,
)
```

Plot a fitted GLM (R fmrireg ``autoplot.fmri_lm``).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| fit           | FmriLm                                                             | The fitted model.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | _required_ |
| kind          | (\'betas\', \'contrasts\', \'hrf\', \'timecourse\', \'residuals\') | ``"betas"`` (alias ``"estimates"``) and ``"contrasts"``: with no ``voxel``, the distribution of t across voxels per event regressor (or t-contrast) with dashed lines at the two-sided p < .001 critical value and, in the right margin, the share of voxels beyond each; with ``voxel``, a coefficient plot of estimates with ``level`` confidence intervals, one panel per event term. ``"hrf"``: the estimated response per condition (the term's HRF basis weighted by the coefficients) with a pointwise confidence band; a curve whose band covers 0 at its peak is dashed and marked "(n.s.)". For several voxels the mean response, a t interval of the mean and faint per-voxel curves. ``"timecourse"``: observed and fitted signal, onsets per condition and residuals for one voxel. ``"residuals"``: residual autocorrelation at lags 1 to 10 against the white-noise range this design induces, OLS and, for AR fits, prewhitened. | `"betas"`  |
| voxel         | int or sequence of int                                             | 0-based voxel index (indices for ``"betas"``, ``"contrasts"``, ``"hrf"`` and ``"residuals"``). ``None``: all voxels for the estimates views, the voxel with the largest \|t\| for ``"hrf"`` and ``"timecourse"``, up to 200 evenly spaced voxels for ``"residuals"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`     |
| level         | float                                                              | Confidence level of intervals and bands.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `0.95`     |
| sample_at     | sequence of float                                                  | Times (s) at which to evaluate the HRF; default ``0, 0.25, ..., 20``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`     |
| direct_labels | bool                                                               | ``"hrf"``: label each curve beside its peak (default) or use a legend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `True`     |
| title         | str                                                                | ``None`` uses the default, ``""`` suppresses it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| subtitle      | str                                                                | ``None`` uses the default, ``""`` suppresses it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| caption       | str                                                                | ``None`` uses the default, ``""`` suppresses it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| figsize       | (float, float)                                                     | Figure size in inches; scaled to the content by default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| ax            | matplotlib Axes                                                    | Draw a single-panel view into this axes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description   |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------|
|        | matplotlib.figure.Figure |               |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Critical values and intervals use the fit's inference df (the
effective df of a robust fit). The time-course and residual views refit
the full design to the voxel by OLS (run by run for runwise fits,
jointly otherwise) from the model's dataset, since a fit keeps no
residuals; for AR or robust fits these are the unweighted counterparts.
